title: 'All this food is now useless': Piles of rubbish after shop freezers hit by cyber-attack
summary_full: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.
summary_public: Dozens of supermarkets in seven European countries dumped huge quantities of food after refrigerators and freezers were targeted in a cyber-attack.
